subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Zener Diodes: Controlled Breakdown
description: A micro-lesson that makes Zener Diodes: Controlled Breakdown usable.

hook.text: Most diodes break under too much reverse voltage. Zener diodes are designed to break safely.

buildup.text: At the Zener voltage, the junction conducts in reverse — but in a controlled, stable way.

discovery.text: This makes a perfect voltage reference. The output stays constant despite input swings.

twist.text: Without Zener diodes, voltage regulators would be far more complex and expensive.

climax.text: Every power supply that needs a precise voltage reference likely contains a Zener diode.

punchline.text: Breakdown is a flaw — unless you engineer it at the right voltage.

quiz.question: What is a Zener diode designed to do?
options: Emit light at a specific wavelength
Conduct in reverse at a precise, stable breakdown voltage
Block current in both directions until heated
